label: authorised representative
definition: A person appointed by a provider to represent them in the Union regarding general-purpose AI models.
source_quote: appoint an authorised representative which is established in the Union

label: appoint an authorised representative which is established in the Union
definition: Providers established in third countries must, prior to placing a general-purpose AI model on the Union market, appoint an authorised representative by written mandate.
source_quote: Prior to placing a general-purpose AI model on the Union market, providers established in third countries shall, by written mandate, appoint an authorised representative which is established in the Union.

label: enable its authorised representative to perform the tasks specified in the mandate
definition: The provider shall enable its authorised representative to perform the tasks specified in the mandate received from the provider.
source_quote: The provider shall enable its authorised representative to perform the tasks specified in the mandate received from the provider.

label: verify that the technical documentation specified in Annex XI has been drawn up
definition: The authorised representative shall verify that the technical documentation specified in Annex XI has been drawn up and all obligations referred to in Article 53 and, where applicable, Article 55 have been fulfilled by the provider.
source_quote: verify that the technical documentation specified in Annex XI has been drawn up and all obligations referred to in Article 53 and, where applicable, Article 55 have been fulfilled by the provider;

label: keep a copy of the technical documentation specified in Annex XI at the disposal
definition: The authorised representative shall keep a copy of the technical documentation specified in Annex XI at the disposal of the AI Office and national competent authorities, for a period of 10 years after the general-purpose AI model has been placed on the market.
source_quote: keep a copy of the technical documentation specified in Annex XI at the disposal of the AI Office and national competent authorities, for a period of 10 years after the general-purpose AI model has been placed on the market

label: provide the AI Office, upon a reasoned request, with all the information and documentation
definition: The authorised representative shall provide the AI Office, upon a reasoned request, with all the information and documentation, including that referred to in point (b), necessary to demonstrate compliance with the obligations in this Chapter.
source_quote: provide the AI Office, upon a reasoned request, with all the information and documentation, including that referred to in point (b), necessary to demonstrate compliance with the obligations in this Chapter;

label: cooperate with the AI Office and competent authorities, upon a reasoned request
definition: The authorised representative shall cooperate with the AI Office and competent authorities, upon a reasoned request, in any action they take in relation to the general-purpose AI model.
source_quote: cooperate with the AI Office and competent authorities, upon a reasoned request, in any action they take in relation to the general-purpose AI model

label: terminate the mandate if it considers or has reason to consider the provider to be acting contrary to its obligations
definition: The authorised representative shall terminate the mandate if it considers or has reason to consider the provider to be acting contrary to its obligations pursuant to this Regulation. In such a case, it shall also immediately inform the AI Office about the termination of the mandate and the reasons therefor.
source_quote: The authorised representative shall terminate the mandate if it considers or has reason to consider the provider to be acting contrary to its obligations pursuant to this Regulation.
